papers.title: Atrophy-related inflammation CSF markers predict clinical progression in genetic frontotemporal dementia
papers.summary: We found 16 t-tests and/or F-tests where effect sizes are not reported. Check these tests in the table below, and consider adding effect sizes.

findings.sentence: The ANCOVA revealed protein-CV scores differed between groups (F(2,229)=41.57, p<0.001) (Figure 1E).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The ANCOVA on the MRI-CV scores identified a similar pattern between groups (F(2,229)=22.92, p<0.001) (Figure 1D), showing that MRI-CV scores in symptomatic carriers were significantly higher than in controls (p<0.001) and presymptomatic carriers (p<0.001), but presymptomatic carriers and controls groups did not differ (p>0.05), with age and sex as significant covariates (p<0.01).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus interaction term between protein-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model on CDR-SB scores was statistically significant (F(2,192)=5.81, p=0.003).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: In contrast, the omnibus interaction term between MRI-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model was statistically significant (F(2,192)=18.31, p<0.001), concordant with the bootstrapped model, where the interaction terms were associated with higher CDR-SB scores within the symptomatic carriers ( =3.80, CI:[0.64,6.20], Figure 2A-left) but not in presymptomatic carriers ( =-0.10, CI:[-0.57,0.28]) nor in controls ( =-0.007, CI:[-0.66, 0.59]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus three-way interaction term in the parametric model was not significantly (F(2,189)=0.26, p=0.9) associated with CDR-SB scores in concordance with the bootstrapped model (Ref group: controls ( =-0.08, CI:[-0.42, 0.27]); presymptomatic carriers ( =0.08, CI:[-0.38,0.44]); symptomatic carriers ( =-0.11, CI:[-3.13, 2.97]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus interaction term between protein-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model with CDR-SB-slopes was statistically significant (F(2,192)=5.59, p=0.004), Ref group: controls), concordant with the bootstrapped model, where the interaction terms were associated with CDR-SB-slopes in symptomatic carriers ( =0.24, CI:[0.02,0.46], Figure 2B-right), but not for presymptomatic carriers ( =0.03, CI:[-0.01, 0.14]), or controls ( = 0.03, CI:[-0.04, 0.09]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: In contrast, the omnibus interaction term between MRI-CV scores and disease group onto CDR-SB-slopes in the parametric model was statistically significant (F(2,192)=3.87, p=0.02, Ref group: controls).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus three-way interaction term in the parametric model was not associated (F(2,189)=0.13, p=0.86) with CDR-SB-slopes in concordance with the bootstrapped model (Ref group: controls =-0.005, CI:[-0.05,0.05]; presymptomatic carriers = 0.007, CI:[-0.07,0.09]; symptomatic carriers ( =-0.032, CI:[-0.35,0.20]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Both CSF inflammatory proteins and fronto-insular atrophy are associated with worse executive function cross-sectionally The omnibus interaction term between protein-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model was statistically significant (F(2,217)=4.19, p=0.02) with DSST scores.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Furthermore, the omnibus interaction term between MRI-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model was statistically (F(2,217)=3.12, p=0.04) associated with DSST scores.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus three-way interaction term in the parametric model was not (F(2,215)=2.03, p=0.13) associated with DSST scores, which is in concordance with the bootstrapped model showing no association with DSST scores (Ref group: controls =-3.73, CI: [-10.32,5.02]; presymptomatic carriers =2.33, CI:[-1.90,7.56]; symptomatic carriers =5.68, CI:[-0.37,12.38]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Contrary, the omnibus interaction term between protein-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model was not (F(2,217)=0.56, p=0.57) associated with DSST-slope, which is in concordance with the bootstrapped model, where the interaction terms were not associated with DSST slopes (Ref group: controls ( =-0.16, CI:[-0.41,0.13]; presymptomatic carriers ( =-0.11, CI:[-0.54,0.15]); symptomatic carriers ( =0.07, CI:[-0.29,0.43], Figure 2D-right).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus interaction term between MRI-CV scores and disease group in the parametric model was not (F(2,221)=2.06, p=0.12) associated with DSST-slopes.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The omnibus three-way interaction term in the parametric model was not (F(2,215)=1.04, p=0.35) associated with DSST-slope (Ref group: controls =0.16, CI:[-0.14,0.38]; presymptomatic carriers =-0.26, CI:[-0.70,0.10]; symptomatic carriers =-0.09, CI:[-0.50,0.31]).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.
